svg.title: brevis.sh — from raw data to modelled tables. In Go.
svg.desc: The brevis.sh wordmark with its mark, the breve. Title: from raw data to modelled tables, in Go. Lead: orchestration, extraction, ingestion and data modelling, the Core, SDK, Gateway and SQL, unified in Go; open source, in your cluster, with no data passing through the orchestrator. Seneca: non exiguum temporis habemus, sed multum perdidimus. Four chips: Core, SDK, Gateway, SQL, each a Go module.
